latestVersion.changelog:
Audio Visualizer Generator v1.0.0

- Initial release, enabling users to easily turn audio files (MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC up to 200MB) into visualizer videos via cloud processing.
- Simple workflow: upload audio, describe desired visual style, and receive a rendered video (MP4 and other formats).
- Automatic token/session management with 100 free credits for new users.
- Quick processing times (typically 30–90 seconds) and support for timeline-based editing.
- Includes status, credits, and export management commands, with clear error handling and helpful usage tips.
